title: Get Fit for Function
official: Get Fit for Function Pilot Study
summary: The purpose of this study will be to implement and evaluate a prehab program for pre-frail and frail adults who need to undergo thoracic surgery. The study team hypothesizes using an implementation framework will increase the reach, effectiveness, adoption, and implementation of the prehab program.

interventions.name: Prehabilitation Program (Apple Watch Series 6 with exercise flipbook)

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age ≥ 18, of any racial or ethnic origin
* Will be undergoing elective thoracic surgery lung resection using thoracic approach (thoracotomy, Video-assisted thoracoscopic surgery (VATS), Robotic-Assisted Thoracic Surgery (RATS)
* Able to complete baseline evaluations at time of enrollment

Exclusion Criteria:

* Unable to give informed consent
* Unable to read/speak English
* Age \<17
